# Model Pattern Errors and Warnings

Messages reported by PostSharp.Patterns.Model: INotifyPropertyChanged, aggregatable objects, undo/redo and weak events.

| Message | Severity | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <xref:dom001?text=DOM001> | Error | A property getter reads a mutable static field or a field of another object. |
| <xref:dom002?text=DOM002> | Error | A property getter calls a static method or a method of another object that returns a value. |
| <xref:dom003?text=DOM003> | Error | A property getter creates a delegate from a method group or a lambda expression. |
| <xref:dom004?text=DOM004> | Error | A method marked with [Pure] has a parameter of a type that is not immutable. |
| <xref:dom007?text=DOM007> | Warning | A property getter reads more than five fields whose type is compatible with the type of the property. |
| <xref:dom008?text=DOM008> | Error | A class implements INotifyPropertyChanged itself but has no OnPropertyChanged(string) method for the aspect. |
| <xref:dom009?text=DOM009> | Error | A class defines a ChildPropertyChanged event or an OnChildPropertyChanged method, whose names the aspect reserves. |
| <xref:dom011?text=DOM011> | Error | The getter of a property calls a virtual method, whose dependencies cannot be analyzed. |
| <xref:dom012?text=DOM012> | Error | Depends.On is called deeper in the call chain than the getter of the property or a method that it calls directly. |
| <xref:dom021?text=DOM021> | Error | A recordable class has a field of a mutable struct type. |
| <xref:dom022?text=DOM022> | Error | A child field of a recordable class has a type that is not recordable. |
| <xref:dom023?text=DOM023> | Warning | A property depends on a property of an object whose type does not notify its changes. |
| <xref:dom025?text=DOM025> | Error | A property depends on a local variable that is assigned inside a try statement. |
| <xref:dom026?text=DOM026> | Error | A recordable class has a public or internal async or iterator method. |
| <xref:dom027?text=DOM027> | Error | The [AggregateAllChanges] attribute is applied to a property whose type is not a collection. |
| <xref:dom028?text=DOM028> | Warning | A method assigns the individual fields of a structure that a field of the class holds. |
| <xref:dom030?text=DOM030> | Warning | The [IgnoreAutoChangeNotification] attribute is applied to a method instead of a property. |
